notes.title: Demo v0.1.54 Hotfix
notes.content: [h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the "Upstanding Citizen" achievement, which is now unlockable and functions as intended[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the Mitosic Arrow weapon stat card to display critical chance instead of showing attack speed twice[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked button mapping on the Wishlist screen so that moving left or right now takes you directly to the "Exit Game" button[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced expired Discord invite link[/p][/*][/list]
